notes: Cash-basis county; all funds governmental, business_type null. Receipts/disbursements from the Total Government Funds column (p3). Property/Motor Vehicle Taxes split per p1 general receipts (Property 21,410,699 + Motor Vehicle 2,349,589). State and Other broad lines split using the fund schedules (General p4, Inheritance/Road p6, Insurance p7, nonmajor total p9); the General Fund statement column shows 926 more in State and 926 less in Other than its p4 budget lines (column totals agree), so the State remainder includes +926 and an Other piece of -926 is recorded. Beginning/ending cash = beginning/ending fund balances rolled forward on p3 (total assets 42,432,843 include 1,256,915 liabilities held as cash); ending_investments = certificates of deposit, informational. Balance sheet = governmental funds cash-basis statement p2 (no government-wide net position statement). Detail: General Fund receipts from p4; General Fund spending from the department-by-object schedule p10 (more detailed than the p4-5 function lines, which are not recorded; department budgets not recorded by object); General Fund transfers in from p5. Statement function columns group the General Fund departments differently from p5/p10 (e.g. Miscellaneous General 3,466,458), so detail functions follow the p10 headings. Major funds from p6-7; nonmajor funds (about 30 columns, p8-9) via the Total Nonmajor column. Inheritance Fund Other Receipts 443,698 split into interest 368,698 (p3) and 75,000. p11 (tax certified analysis) has no cash-flow data. Read pages 1-11 of 11
